list.name: segment
list.label: Segment
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT metric_json->>'segment' AS segment FROM metrics WHERE metric_json IS NOT NULL AND metric_json->>'segment' IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1;

list.name: project
list.label: Project
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT project FROM metrics WHERE project IS NOT NULL AND (CASE WHEN COALESCE('$segment','') = '' THEN TRUE ELSE metric_json->>'segment' = '$segment' END) ORDER BY 1;

targets.rawSql: WITH latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (project) project, COALESCE(score, metric_value) AS val FROM metrics WHERE metric_key = 'overall_maturity_score' AND (CASE WHEN COALESCE('$segment','') = '' THEN TRUE ELSE metric_json->>'segment' = '$segment' END) ORDER BY project, observed_at DESC) SELECT ROUND(AVG(val)::numeric, 3) AS overall_maturity FROM latest WHERE (CASE WHEN COALESCE('${project:csv}','') = '' THEN TRUE ELSE project IN (${project:csv}) END);

SELECT COUNT(*) AS runs_7d FROM runs WHERE COALESCE(finished_at, started_at) >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' AND (CASE WHEN COALESCE('${project:csv}','') = '' THEN TRUE ELSE project IN (${project:csv}) END);

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status='succeeded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0), 1) AS success_rate FROM runs WHERE COALESCE(finished_at, started_at) >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' AND (CASE WHEN COALESCE('${project:csv}','') = '' THEN TRUE ELSE project IN (${project:csv}) END);

SELECT ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (finished_at - started_at)))/60.0, 1) AS avg_min FROM runs WHERE finished_at IS NOT NULL AND started_at IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(finished_at, started_at) >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' AND (CASE WHEN COALESCE('${project:csv}','') = '' THEN TRUE ELSE project IN (${project:csv}) END);

SELECT time_bucket('1 week', observed_at) AS time, AVG(COALESCE(score, metric_value)) AS maturity FROM metrics WHERE metric_key='overall_maturity_score' AND $__timeFilter(observed_at) AND (CASE WHEN COALESCE('$segment','') = '' THEN TRUE ELSE metric_json->>'segment' = '$segment' END) AND (CASE WHEN COALESCE('${project:csv}','') = '' THEN TRUE ELSE project IN (${project:csv}) END) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time;
